mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `cq-hospital`.purchase_report (name, quantity, supplier_address, supplier_leader, supplier_name, supplier_phone, supplier_price, date, total_price) VALUES (#{name}, #{quantity}, #{supplierAddress}, #{supplierLeader}, #{supplierName}, #{supplierPhone}, #{supplierPrice}, #{date}, #{totalPrice})
mapper.select: SELECT s.id, s.hospital_id, s.department_id, s.stock, s.`name`, s.price, s.manufacturer, s.sell_by, s.supplier_id, s.type, s.status FROM `cq-hospital`.`stock` s JOIN `cq-hospital`.hospital h ON s.hospital_id = h.id JOIN `cq-hospital`.department dpt ON s.department_id = dpt.id JOIN `cq-hospital`.doctor doc ON doc.hospital_id = h.id JOIN `cq-hospital`.user u ON doc.user_id = u.id WHERE doc.user_id = #{doctorId}

SELECT s.id, s.name, s.stock, dpt.name AS department, s.manufacturer, s.sell_by, su.name AS supplier, s.price, s.status FROM `cq-hospital`.`stock` s JOIN `cq-hospital`.department dpt ON s.department_id = dpt.id JOIN `cq-hospital`.purchase p ON p.stock_id = s.id JOIN `cq-hospital`.supplier su ON su.id = p.supplier_id JOIN `cq-hospital`.hospital h ON h.id = s.hospital_id JOIN `cq-hospital`.admin ad ON ad.hospital_id = h.id WHERE s.type = #{type} AND ad.id = #{hospitalAdminId}

SELECT su.name, ss.price, su.address, su.phone, su.leader FROM `cq-hospital`.stock s JOIN `cq-hospital`.supply_stock ss ON ss.med_name = s.name JOIN `cq-hospital`.supplier su ON su.id = ss.supplier WHERE s.name = #{name}
